g.text: A one-task DAG submitted through the console, from ExecutionService/SubmitExecution to SUCCEEDED. Solid arrows are calls, dashed are returns.
2. resolveCaller: session JWT or bot token → caller {teamNames, isAdmin, scopes} · requireCaller, audit (interceptors)
3. withProductIdentities · authorizeTasks: a member of each task's team?
team not retired? runs as its product's identity (identityRefusal)? each secretRef its team's? (isSecretRegistered)
4. refuseBlockedImages: image policy · registry (registry.ts) · pinned: tag → digest · refuseUnscanned: scan verdicts
6. kernel/client.ts submitExecution: the JSON as a request (only the names checked) → KernelService/SubmitExecution
7. Callers.Interceptor: the console's token? (TokenReview, cached 60 s) → SubmitExecution
8. SELECT by idempotency_key: seen before? return it (created false, no new rows)
9. taskDefs: each field · domain.ValidateDAG: duplicate ids, unknown dependencies, cycles, $fromTask references
each task READY (no dependencies), AWAITING_APPROVAL (no dependencies, needs one) or BLOCKED
10. a savepoint: INSERT executions, execution_tasks, task_dependencies · recordEvent EXECUTION_CREATED
12. recordOrCancel: recordSubmittedExecution(executionId, teams, submittedBy, name, payload)
recoverExpiredLeases; SELECT READY … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
→ CLAIMED, lease_owner, attempt_count+1, task_attempts row, TASK_CLAIMED
17. createJob ek-…: args=[action], serviceAccount, secret volumes · createConfigMap ek-…: request.json, owned by the Job
18. admission: dispatch-policy · image-policy · identity-policy · image signature (GKE)
refused → DispatchRejected → task FAILED, not retried
21. recordStart: task RUNNING · TASK_STARTED · markExecutionRunning (execution RUNNING)
22. does the work; writes /platform/output/result.json (read back as the termination message)
23. next pass: its RUNNING tasks → poll: execution cancelled? past timeout_seconds?
24. Status(handle) (skipped while the watch saw no change)
25. GET the Job: still running → RUNNING (lease_expires_at extended; logs every 60 s)
loop [while the Job runs: one poll per pass; a watched change wakes the loop]
releaseReadyDependents (BLOCKED → READY, or AWAITING_APPROVAL, once every dependency SUCCEEDED) · settleExecution
29. once the pass has committed: ReleaseFinished → Release(handle)
31. failed: handleFailure → ShouldRetry? READY again after the backoff (claimed by a later pass)
otherwise FAILED → failExecution (execution FAILED; its READY/BLOCKED/AWAITING_APPROVAL tasks CANCELLED)
loop [kernel-scheduler: a pass at once after progress, else on a watched change or the poll interval (1 s)]
32. WatchExecution {executionId} (loadExecution: a member of any of its teams, re-checked on every read)
34. state, tasks [state, attempts, outputs, failure, dependsOn]
35. the execution, each time it changes, until it finishes (a stream)
